cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) with two prominent buffers Coco-Glucoside (3) and Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4), no reinforcing route; E3 point Parfum (20). Refatting counter-signals (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil 6, Glyceryl Oleate 8) recorded; convention robust with two buffers.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful lipid/cationic system - prominent Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil (6) with Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (9) and weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate (8) - plus humectants Erythritol (11), Glycerin (12), Panthenol (13), hyaluronates (17, 18). C2 not met: the payload lipid takes the silicone's place but there is no separate pearlizing/fatty route. Counter-signal: close to C2 -> neighbor high.

formulaIdentifiers.sourceTier: frozen packet canonical INCI (tier not stated)

excluded: Lactic Acid (7), Citric Acid (16) - pH adjusters

depositionLoad.rationale: Early waxy hydrogenated oil plus cationic guar plus weak refatter: W-RICH formally met.

persistence.rationale: Hydrogenated (waxy) lipid is more substantive than a liquid oil (6.4); guar coacervates with it; no silicone.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLES with two buffers: normal reset, not limited, not clarifying.

weightPotential.counterEvidence: W-RICH and an early waxy lipid pull toward high; two-buffer sulfate reset and the absence of silicone/second polymer pull toward moderate.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A lipid/guar coacervate system plausibly leaves bounded noticeable residue; the reset is not limited.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the high anchor needs rich architecture with limited reset or multiple persistent systems; reset is a normal two-buffer SLES chassis, there is one cationic polymer and no silicone. Not low: an early waxy payload lipid converging with guar (W-RICH, W2) makes 'lightweight' an understatement. W1 does not apply (early waxy lipid).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Lipid level unknown; waxy lipid at position 6 makes high a realistic neighbor.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate (depositionLoad moderate, persistence moderate, resetCapacity moderate); neighbor high.
weightPotential.selfCheck: Fingerprint matches; blind judgment; 'ohne zu beschweren' (retailer) ignored per 6.5 step 5; no count/position assigned band; subjudgments present; whyNotNeighborBand specific; no in-lane comparison.
